flows.name: generate_course_blueprint
flows.trigger: authorized LMS admin/trainer requests learning design
flows.response: blueprint request reference, then approved CourseBlueprintContract

flows.name: publish_blueprint_to_lms
flows.trigger: LMS accepts an approved immutable blueprint version
flows.response: LMS Course Draft plus projection acknowledgement

flows.name: learning_result_feedback
flows.trigger: delivery milestone, completion, or quiz attempt outcome
flows.guardrail: LMS completion, pass, or certificate cannot automatically verify a PAI competency.
